questions.question_text: Which interval is equal to $1.25$ hours?

options.why: Treats 0.25 hour as 25 minutes rather than one quarter of 60 minutes.
Treats 0.25 hour as one third of an hour rather than one quarter.
Uses three quarters of an hour instead of one quarter.
Converts to 1 hour 42 minutes, one minute shorter than the greatest duration.
Converts to 1 hour 41 minutes, two minutes shorter than the greatest duration.

questions.solution_text:
$1.7\text{ h}=1\text{ h }42\text{ min}$
$101\text{ min}=1\text{ h }41\text{ min}$
The longest duration is $1\text{ h }43\text{ min}$.
